title: French Cheese Tartine
description: A simple yet delicious French-inspired cheese tartine made with vibrant ingredients. Enjoy as a snack or light lunch.
instructions: 2. Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast for 5-7 minutes.
3. Spread a layer of butter on each toasted bread slice.
4. Top each bread slice with a spoonful of crumbled cheese and a sprinkle of chopped thyme.
5. Return the baking sheet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
